abi.boundary_rule: Every C variable lives in its assigned stack slot at boundaries. Only an explicitly declared boolean result may feed the immediately following controller branch.
abi.return_rule: Put the C return value in the ABI result register and branch to return_label; never emit ret in a fragment.
abi.calls: Preserve live caller-saved temporaries across calls. The scaffold keeps SP 16-byte aligned.
